security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's SPMP TOR address matching for entry i incorrectly requires the preceding entry i-1 to be active (spmpen[i-1]==1 or spmpcfg[i-1].A!=OFF) before using spmpaddr[i-1] as the lower bound. The spec explicitly states TOR matching is 'independent of the configuration or activation state of the preceding entry, i.e., spmpcfg[i-1] and spmpen[i-1]'.
security_spec.summary: SPMP TOR matching must use spmpaddr[i-1] as lower bound regardless of preceding entry's spmpen or A field state; deactivating entry i-1 via spmpen must not break TOR region i's address matching

findings.finding: SPMP (Sspmp) extension is not implemented in this QEMU codebase. No spmpcfg, spmpaddr, spmpen CSRs, no spmp_tor_match function, no spmp_hart_has_privs, and no SPMP TOR matching logic exist. The vulnerability pattern described (spmp_tor_match incorrectly gating on spmpen[i-1]) cannot manifest because there is no SPMP code to contain the bug. The only modified file (hw/riscv/riscv-iommu.c) contains an unrelated IOMMU validation check.
